body_markdown:
In April, we launched our[BookFunnel integration](https://blog.backerkit.com/backerkits-new-bookfunnel-integration-boost-book-pledges-with-instant-access-rewards/) to power Instant Access Rewards, allowing authors and publishers to automatically deliver digital content the moment backers pledge, reserve, or follow a[BackerKit](https://www.backerkit.com/?ref=blog.backerkit.com) campaign.


This solved and supported ebook, audiobook, and bonus content delivery to backers *before* a campaign even ended.


Now, our Bookfunnel integration is available in[BackerKit Pledge Manager](https://www.backerkit.com/pledge-manager?ref=blog.backerkit.com) to streamline digital reward fulfillment *after* the campaign ends.


**For backers,** this means their digital rewards appear in their BookFunnel library, and they can also access those rewards through a download link - a link unique to each backer - from within their BackerKit dashboard.


**For creators,** this means no more manual fulfillment for digital downloads after a campaign wraps. Connect your BookFunnel account once, then automate digital reward distribution for good.


Through this expansion of our BookFunnel integration, the[BackerKit Crowdfunding Platform](https://www.backerkit.com/for-creators?ref=blog.backerkit.com) is now the only platform that can streamline BookFunnel digital content delivery across the full campaign lifecycle.


## Key Benefits


- **Automate post-campaign digital content delivery** in just a few clicks
- **Avoid manual errors** to maintain positive backer experience and brand reputation
- **Send titles to backers’ BookFunnel libraries** *and* via unique links
- **Monitor download link usage** via BookFunnel
- **Connect the integration once** and enable for every future campaign
- **Update files in BookFunnel** , no re-uploading or resending


> "This collaboration is huge. We’ve been begging for this to be seamless for years – and you all made it happen. We can’t emphasize how game-changing this is for authors. It’s really big – and it will really impact the reader experience." - Katee Robert and Jenny Nordbak,[Bonkers Romance](https://www.backerkit.com/c/users/2123367/profile?ref=blog.backerkit.com)


**Related:** Check out[Romance Marketplace](https://www.backerkit.com/c/worlds/romance-marketplace?ref=blog.backerkit.com) , a BackerKit World by Bonkers Romance


## How It Works


For backers, it's the same experience as every other BackerKit digital download - plus a copy waiting in their BookFunnel library.


1. Once you start distribution on BackerKit Pledge Manager, backers receive a BackerKit notification email letting them know their digital rewards are ready.
2. Their book shows up in their BookFunnel library right away.
3. They can also click the download link on their BackerKit rewards page to view and download the file immediately. No BookFunnel account? The link works on its own.


## Getting Started


To deliver BookFunnel rewards through BackerKit Pledge Manager, you'll need:


- A BookFunnel *Best Seller* or *Publisher* plan.[Explore BookFunnel today >>](https://bookfunnel.com/pricing/?ref=blog.backerkit.com)
- An active BackerKit Pledge Manager project.[Get started with BackerKit Pledge Manager >>](https://www.backerkit.com/pledge-manager?ref=blog.backerkit.com)
- A BookFunnel API key. Contact BookFunnel support at support@bookfunnel.com to have it enabled.


[See the full setup guide](https://blog.backerkit.com/content/files/2026/11/974-how-do-i-integrate-with-bookfunnel-in-pledge-manager.html) .


**BackerKit Pledge Manager is part of the BackerKit Crowdfunding Platform.**[Get a demo BackerKit today >>](https://form.typeform.com/to/B7alFvbe?ref=blog.backerkit.com)
